tools.name: analyze_iban
tools.description: Look up which bank an IBAN belongs to. Returns the registered bank name, BIC/SWIFT code and address where it is published, plus whether the IBAN is structurally valid, the country and its SEPA status. Where no bank is returned the result says why: a bank code that was never issued reads differently

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Check whether IBANs are structurally valid - length, country, checksum - without looking up the bank behind them. Use this when the question is only 'is this typed correctly'; use analyze_iban when the answer needs to name a bank. Costs one validation from the caller's monthly allowance.

tools.name: get_country_iban_format
tools.description: The IBAN length and SEPA status for one country, and whether its IBANs are approved for international use. Free - costs no allowance.

tools.name: list_supported_countries
tools.description: Every country this service knows, and for each one whether IBAN validation and bank lookup are available. Use it to find out in advance whether a country can be answered at all. Free - costs no allowance.

tools.name: get_allowance
tools.description: How much of the caller's monthly allowance is left, which plan it belongs to and when it resets. Check this before a long run of lookups. Free - costs no allowance.
